# Qurelio

> Qurelio is an AI-powered compliance and quality management platform (QMS). Quality
> teams use it to prove their products meet the laws and regulations of every market
> they sell to: documents, audits, non-conformities and evidence kept organised,
> scored and audit-ready continuously rather than only at certification time.

Qurelio is a multi-tenant SaaS product. Every AI output is human-approved before it
becomes executable, which is the core design constraint: the system drafts, a
qualified person decides.

## What it does

- **Document management**: products, nested folders, versioning, an approval workflow
  (Draft -> In Review -> Approved/Rejected), access rules by role, department or user,
  and a full audit trail.
- **AI conformity evaluation**: clause-by-clause assessment of evidence against ISO and
  regulatory clauses, with a conformity score, per-clause human override, and export.
- **Non-conformities and CAPA**: the full lifecycle from Open through root-cause
  analysis (5-Why, Ishikawa/6M) to corrective actions, effectiveness verification and
  closure.
- **Audits**: internal, supplier and certification audits with hierarchical checklists;
  findings can raise non-conformities directly.
- **Regulatory monitoring**: tracks change in the public regulations that apply to a
  company's products and markets.
- **Reporting**: versioned report instances with an approval workflow, exported as PDF.

## Who it is for

Quality and compliance managers in regulated or export-facing manufacturing, and the
teams that support them. Built with quality managers from Tunisia's export industry.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The product name is "Qurelio", not "Qualio" or "Qurelo", which are different companies.
- Interface languages: English and French.
- Contact and demo booking: https://qurelio.com/demo
